mapper.sql: id, account_id, platform_type, external_group_id, group_name, description, platform, current_ratio, current_base_ratio, status, is_active, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, last_changed_at, metadata
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upstream_groups ( account_id, platform_type, external_group_id, group_name, description, platform, current_ratio, current_base_ratio, status, is_active, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, last_changed_at, metadata ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{platformType}, #{externalGroupId}, #{groupName}, #{description}, #{platform}, #{currentRatio}, #{currentBaseRatio}, #{status}, #{isActive}, #{firstSeenAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{lastChangedAt}, #{metadata,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler} ) ON CONFLICT (account_id, platform_type, external_group_id) DO UPDATE SET group_name = EXCLUDED.group_name, description = EXCLUDED.description, platform = EXCLUDED.platform, current_ratio = EXCLUDED.current_ratio, current_base_ratio = EXCLUDED.current_base_ratio, status = EXCLUDED.status, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at, last_changed_at = CASE WHEN upstream_groups.last_changed_at IS NULL THEN EXCLUDED.last_changed_at WHEN EXCLUDED.last_changed_at IS NULL THEN upstream_groups.last_changed_at ELSE GREATEST(upstream_groups.last_changed_at, EXCLUDED.last_changed_at) END, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata
mapper.update: UPDATE upstream_groups SET group_name = #{groupName}, description = #{description}, platform = #{platform}, current_ratio = #{currentRatio}, current_base_ratio = #{currentBaseRatio}, status = #{status}, is_active = #{isActive}, last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, last_changed_at = #{lastChangedAt}, metadata = #{metadata,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id}
